status: approved by the owner on 2026-10-18 after the practical evaluation (recommended by a Fable review)
applies_to: docs/research/care-maintenance-practical-contract-2026-10-17.md, which left the required lead time and allowed false-alarm rate to the owner

observations.interval_lengths_hours: 8 of 12 anomaly intervals are about 168 h (seven 168.0, one 168.2); the others are 279, 336, 336 and 757 h: likely an annotation default, not a measured onset
observations.own_model_detections_by_asset: A:0 2 of 3, A:10 1 of 3, other assets 0
observations.own_vs_native_baseline: 3 vs 2 of 12, not distinguishable (3/12 95% CI about 5-57%)

lead_time.rationale: 72 h is the minimum to re-plan a crew, bring an inspection forward and order consumables; 24 h supports a stop/curtail decision only; 168 h is not used on CARE because the intervals look like a default (use it only on data with measured intervals, e.g. offshore)

false_alarms.unit: false episodes per asset per 30 days (record: per 1000 normal record-hours)

ceiling.meaning: analyst triage without a site visit

target.meaning: an alarm can trigger a site visit

care_farm_a.status: already-read development material: comparison only, no pass/fail
promising_if_all: hits at W=72 h >= native-support baseline hits at W=72 h + 3 (currently >= 4 of 12)
normal false episodes <= 3 and normal alarm time not above the native-support baseline
care_farm_a.reporting: counts with Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals, no p-values; the +3 margin is a decision rule, not a significance claim

practically_useful_minimum.detection: at least 50% of attainable events at W=72 h and at least 60% at W=24 h
practically_useful_minimum.false_alarms: within the ceiling per asset and pooled; the target is reported as the aspiration
practically_useful_minimum.below: under 50% at W=72 h the tool is an occasional hint, not an inspection planner

use.holdout: CARE Farm B (15 files) and Farm C (58 files), not yet used for evaluation: fix these criteria, the signal mapping (from metadata only) and the split before opening, then score once; the only route to an acceptance claim
use.lead_proxy_reading: report lead to event_end and normalized earliness; flag intervals equal to the 168 h default (a W=72 h hit there means detected within the first 4 days of a default window)

current_status.own_model: W=72 h 2/12; false episodes 0.51 per asset-30 days pooled (within the ceiling) but 2.41 for asset A:21 (2 episodes in 597 normal record-hours, above the ceiling): fails detection and the per-asset false-alarm ceiling; no advantage over the native-support baseline (1/12 at 72 h, 1.00 pooled, 1.91 at A:11)
current_status.foundation_models_same_alarm_rule: 0-1/12; a different alarm design (quantile-band exceedance, residual against a frozen-normal forecast) may be worth a contract with Chronos-2 and Toto 2 only (TimesFM 3 excluded by licence)
